readout_other: 18F-florbetaben amyloid PET; contrast-enhanced MRI T1 mapping for putative glymphatic activity; DCE-MRI BBB permeability; neuropsychological tests
direction_notes: Cognitive scores improved and amyloid deposition decreased mainly in APOE4 carriers after 4 weeks of LIUS; putative glymphatic activity increased in cortex but not after multiple-comparison correction.
safety_notes: All 10 patients completed the 4-week treatment and no significant adverse events were seen on clinical assessment; no significant changes in BBB integrity, microbleeds or brain volume.

target.label: posterior fontanelle and lateral area of the head (unfocused transducers)

timing.protocol_description: Pulse duration 100 ms at 1 Hz PRF; 30 min of sonication per session, three sessions per week for 4 weeks, four unfocused transducers positioned in pairs on the front and sides of the head.
